The camera reads the code on the watch. You can also type it below.
This copy of the app can\'t reach a watch
You are using the Agent app inside a work profile or Secure Folder. Watches only talk to the main profile. Close this one, open the Agent app from your normal home screen, and pair there.
Google Play services is missing
Watches pair through Google Play services, which this phone does not have or has switched off. Update or enable it, then try again.
No watch is connected to this phone
Turn Bluetooth on and check that your watch shows as connected in the Galaxy Wearable or Wear OS app. If you have just set it up, give it a minute. Being on the same Wi-Fi also works.
The watch did not answer
It did not answer over Bluetooth and this phone is not on Wi-Fi. Connect to the same Wi-Fi as the watch, keep the pairing screen open on the watch, then try again.
The watch did not answer
The watch is connected but did not reply. Keep its pairing screen open with the screen on, make sure the phone and watch are on the same Wi-Fi, then try again.
That did not work
The watch refused. Check the code on its screen.
Could not pair
